This city gave my family a place to call home and shaped who I am. I'm running for Council to ensure it can do the same for future generations.

I bring more than 16 years of experience in finance, strategy, and planning, and I serve as Chair of the City's Advisory Planning Commission. This work has taught me to ask difficult questions, weigh different perspectives, and focus on measurable and practical outcomes.

My priorities are thoughtful growth and housing, with the right homes for families, renters, seniors, and essential workers, supported by the infrastructure and services a growing city needs. I'll advocate for safer, more welcoming neighbourhoods, vibrant public spaces, and the local businesses that give our community its character. I'll push for a City Hall that brings people in earlier, explains decisions clearly, and follows through.

I'd be honoured to bring a thoughtful, practical, and collaborative voice to Council.
